candidates.change_summary: Replace the assignment with `MinSum = _val + 1;` so the stored MinSum always differs from the value passed by the caller.
Delete the assignment `MinSum = _val;` so MinSum remains 0 regardless of the argument.
Delete the initialization guard so SetMinSum also succeeds after `Initialized()` has been called, allowing MinSum to change in states where the original reverts.
Remove the `if(intitalized)revert();` guard so MinSum can be changed after initialization.
Assign a fixed value 0 to MinSum instead of the parameter, changing the observable stored value.
Set the Log file address to the zero address instead of the provided _log argument.
Delete the assignment that stores _log, leaving the Log state variable at its previous (zero) value.
Remove the intitalized guard so the log file address can still be overwritten after initialization.
Delete the statement `acc.balance += msg.value;` so deposited funds are never credited to the sender's holder balance.
Replace `acc.balance += msg.value;` with `acc.balance = msg.value;` so each deposit overwrites the balance instead of accumulating it.

Change the unlockTime update to always assign `acc.unlockTime = block.timestamp + _lockTime;` (removing the greater-than guard), which changes the recorded holder state after Put when the new lock time is not strictly larger.
Delete the statement that reduces acc.balance by _am before the transfer, so the recorded balance is not decreased after Collect.
Change the condition `acc.balance>=MinSum` to `acc.balance>MinSum` so withdrawals are blocked when balance equals MinSum.
Delete the `Log.AddMessage(msg.sender,_am,"Collect")` call so a successful Collect is no longer recorded in the log observable via LogFile.History.
Remove the `block.timestamp>acc.unlockTime` time-lock check so funds can be collected before the unlock time.
